body:
Tested locally, it works as expected. Code looks good to me.

**Testing project:** [test_pr_105655.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/19871197/test_pr_105655.zip)

Some feedback not strictly related to this PR, but I'll mention it here for completeness:

- When importing all editor icons in a project, this is printed many times on initial import. However, the source file path isn't printed, which means you can't easily find the cause of this error.

```
ERROR: Failed generating icon, unsupported or invalid SVG data in default theme.
   at: _load_at_scale (./scene/resources/svg_texture.cpp:189)
```

- Sprite3D does not make use of SVGTexture automatic rescaling, unlike Sprite2D and TextureRect:
  - https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/12842

![Screenshot_20250423_170657](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/9f0c798a-c366-4baa-ad65-e16db4a63c7e)

![Screenshot_20250423_170702](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/82042e90-6194-4edf-97ae-f6027bb82086)

- There's a black fringe present around some oversampled icons, as seen in the above screenshot. It's not present at native resolution.
